Report mandates (14 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Post a report on its website and provide a written report to the Speaker of the Council, including specified program information and recommendations.
    report · deadline 2018-03-01 · one-time · Section 1(c) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Conduct and submit to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post conspicuously on the department’s website, an annual study on bicycle activity during the previous calendar year.
    report · deadline 2023-02-01 · annual · § 19-187.1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Identify the streets most frequently biked with and without protected bike lanes.
    report · deadline 2023-02-01 · annual · § 19-187.1(a) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Identify the bridges most frequently biked with and without protected bike lanes.
    report · deadline 2023-02-01 · annual · § 19-187.1(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Propose recommendations for improving bicycle safety and flow on the identified streets and bridges and other locations suitable for biking in the city.
    report · deadline 2023-02-01 · annual · § 19-187.1(c) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Conduct a study on the feasibility of implementing Barnes dance pedestrian crossing systems at dangerous intersections; identify the 25 intersections reflecting the greatest danger for pedestrians; determine whether a Barnes dance could be implemented at each; post the study results on its website; and submit the results to the council.
    report · deadline: No later than December 1, 2016 · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · The commissioner shall publish on the department’s website a report on the department’s recent outreach and education efforts.
    report · one-time · § 19-195(e) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Conduct a study on reducing crowding in locations with heavy pedestrian traffic; identify the ten locations with the heaviest pedestrian volume and develop strategies for improving safety and traffic flow at those locations.
    report · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the speaker of the council regarding the progress of the pilot program, including whether the department recommends implementing a permanent shared electric scooter program and any appropriate recommendations concerning governing laws, rules, regulations, and policies.
    report · deadline: Prior to the completion of such pilot · one-time · Section 1(e) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report on implementation of daylighting and installation of daylighting features, containing the specified intersection, feasibility, discontinuance, criteria, and alternative-measure information.
    report · deadline: No later than December 1, 2023 · annual · § 19-175.8(f) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on its website and submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report on the results of the pilot project.
    report · deadline: no later than 180 days after the pilot concludes · one-time · Section 1(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the mayor and speaker of the council containing recommendations on whether to expand or make the program permanent, and identifying challenges and issues presented by the program.
    report · deadline: No later than 1 year after the conclusion of this program · one-time · § 1(c) · Source law↗

Sources and measure definitions

  • IBO New York City Fiscal History: actual department expenditures in publisher $000s, shown here in USD; staffing is actual full-time positions reported as of June 30. Publisher vintage FY2022.
  • CityScroll registered-contract measures use the AP-03 population snapshot and mean registered contract value, not actual spending.
  • Actual payments use the separate AP-08 Checkbook Spending population and are shown only as the AP-09 payment fact.

These sources use different accounting and population scopes. Current snapshots have IBO fiscal years FY1980–FY2022 and procurement/payment years FY2025–FY2027; a blank measure is labeled Unknown because the publisher does not report a value for that year. No outsourcing or efficiency score is calculated.
